summary: A movement that began in outrage has delivered remarkable election upset, showing that change is possible and prompting questions over what comes next• Don’t get This Is Europe delivered to your inbox?

The aim of the arduous, 13-day transcontinental journey was simple: to make their voices heard in Europe and beyond.In their home city of Novi Sad, students had been holding near-daily protests after a deadly roof collapse at the city’s main railway station.
